sentences.en: Leopards are the most versatile of all the big cats.
sentences.zh: 豹是所有大型猫科动物中最多才多艺的。

sentences.en: The bonus travelog film is packaged in a splendid digital versatile disc.
sentences.zh: 额外的旅行记录片被包装在精美的数字多功能光盘中。

sentences.en: The Lord is versatile: He giveth and taketh.
sentences.zh: 上帝是多变的：他给予也收回。

phrases.zh: 非常 versatile - 非常多才多艺
quite versatile - 相当多才多艺

senses.zh: 多才多艺的，全能的：different things；易改变的：fluctuating readily
